subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a public reasoning display-format setting, and should that setting be channel-specific, agent/global, or owned only by the Telegram plugin?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding a config surface affects public schema, default compatibility, channel plugin ownership, and cross-channel rendering semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Add Channel-Owned Format Config
options.body: Preserve italic as the default and add a Telegram/channel-owned display-format option with full delivery-path, schema, docs, and test coverage.

options.title: Add Global Agent Format Config
options.body: Make reasoning display format an agent/default-level policy shared by channels, accepting broader cross-channel API and compatibility review.

options.title: Decline New Config For Now
options.body: Keep the current fixed display and address readability through targeted Telegram rendering improvements or parse-mode work instead.

recommendation.title: Add Channel-Owned Format Config
recommendation.body: Preserve italic as the default and add a Telegram/channel-owned display-format option with full delivery-path, schema, docs, and test coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-source and prior-review signal across the formatter, Telegram reasoning path, docs, and config-surface policy.
